capabilities: Color or highlight matched text automatically in Live Preview and Reading view
Match text with contains/exact/starts-with/ends-with modes, regex, and moment.js date formats
Style entries with presets, quick menu styles, and per-entry custom CSS
Exclude specific files, folders, tags, or properties from coloring
Back up and restore color configuration on a schedule
extras: A deprecation notice states the One-Time Actions feature will be removed and moved to a dedicated plugin. Installation is via Obsidian Community Plugins; bug reports go through GitHub issues and translations are accepted via pull requests.
motivation: The author says they personally use Color Line with custom CSS for center-aligning their tasks, and credits user feedback for the plugin's development.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to persistently color specific words or patterns everywhere they appear across notes.
summary: Automatic text colorer that applies assigned colors and highlights to words, dates, and regex patterns across the vault in Live Preview and Reading view.
